description: Retrieval evaluation set for the hybrid RAG pipeline. Ground truth is defined by evidence phrases rather than hard-coded chunk IDs, so the labels survive changes to CHUNK_SIZE / CHUNK_OVERLAP: a chunk is relevant if it comes from the named document AND contains at least one evidence phrase (case-insensitive, whitespace-normalized). Each item is tagged with the retrieval mode it is designed to stress.

categories.lexical: Rare literal tokens (error codes, identifiers). Embeddings blur these; BM25 nails them.
categories.semantic: Paraphrase with little or no term overlap. BM25 scores near zero; embeddings match easily.
categories.mixed: Both signals available; tests that fusion does not degrade the easy case.
categories.unanswerable: Not covered by any document. Used to calibrate the abstention threshold.
